name: richmond-showreel

scripts.stills:all: node scripts/stills.mjs Vertical && node scripts/stills.mjs Square && node scripts/stills.mjs Wide
scripts.render:vertical: npx remotion render src/index.tsx Vertical renders/showreel-9x16.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=256k
scripts.render:square: npx remotion render src/index.tsx Square renders/showreel-1x1.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=256k
scripts.render:wide: npx remotion render src/index.tsx Wide renders/showreel-16x9.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=256k
scripts.render:all: npm run render:vertical && npm run render:square && npm run render:wide

description: 25-second motion-graphics showreel for the Richmond Employee Payroll Loan Platform (Remotion). Not part of the pnpm workspace.
